title: Mackerel and warm potato salad
summary: Mackerel and warm potato salad is a british dinner built around mackerel fillets and new potatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook mackerel fillets for Mackerel and warm potato salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm little gem lettuce alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss new potatoes with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Mackerel and warm potato salad straight away. Taste Mackerel and warm potato salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
